title: EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.14324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path

translated_title: EV-JEPA：适用于任意设备与跨设备推理的弹性 V-JEPA
translated_abstract: 像 V-JEPA 这样的基础模型正越来越多地部署在异构的边云连续体上，涵盖智能眼镜、手机、机器人和服务器。然而，它们通常被训练为绑定单一设备的刚性、固定容量网络，既不支持可重新配置的计算预算，也不支持协同执行。现有方法每次只能解决其中一个维度：可裁剪和基于 NAS 的方法提供了宽度弹性，但假设单设备推理；而分割计算方法仅在固定分区和静态容量下实现跨设备协作。我们提出了弹性 V-JEPA（EV-JEPA），这是一个只需训练一次、即可部署在连续体中任何位置的单一模型。其宽度可重新配置，并且可以原生地在异构设备间进行分区。其核心是转换感知三元组训练。在每一步中，我们选取一个窄宽度和一个宽宽度，并训练三条路径：两个宽度各自的路径，外加一条混合路径。
tldr: 提出 EV-JEPA，通过转换感知三元组训练（T3）训练出宽度可配置且可原生跨异构设备分区的单一基础模型，一次训练即可部署于从智能眼镜到服务器的任意设备，并同时支持单设备弹性推理与跨设备协同推理。
en_tdlr: EV-JEPA is a single foundation model trained once via Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3), featuring reconfigurable width and native partitionability across heterogeneous devices, enabling both elastic single-device inference and cross-device collaborative inference along the edge-cloud continuum.
